import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix species label variants (strip spaces)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    
    # Fix island label variants (normalize case)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.lower().str.title()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text (with commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
